operations.name: Cancel agent response
operations.description: Requests cancellation of response `{id}`. Acts on durable state, so it works for background runs that outlive the client connection. Cancellation is asynchronous: a `200` acknowledges the request (`status: cancelling`) and the run stops shortly after - poll `GET /v1/agent/{id}` for its terminal status. Cancelling a run that is already terminal returns `400`. Ownership is enforced server side; a cr

operations.name: Create chat completion
operations.description: Generate a chat completion response for the given conversation.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of completion tokens to generate

model.description: Model to use, for example, sonar-pro

stream.description: If true, returns streaming SSE response

stop.description: Stop sequences. Generation stops when one of these strings is produced

temperature.description: Controls randomness in the response. Higher values make output more random. Range: 0-2

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. Controls diversity via nucleus sampling

response_format.description: Optional. Controls the output format. Omit for default text output. Set `type` to `json_schema` for structured output.

messages.description: Array of messages forming the conversation history

web_search_options.description: Configuration options for web search behavior

search_mode.description: Source of search results (web, academic, or sec)

return_images.description: When true, include image results in the response

return_related_questions.description: When true, generates suggested follow-up queries based on the search results

enable_search_classifier.description: When true, uses a classifier to determine if web search is needed for the query

disable_search.description: When true, disables all web search capabilities. The model responds based solely on its training data

search_domain_filter.description: Limit search results to specific domains (e.g. github.com, wikipedia.org)

search_language_filter.description: Filter results by language using ISO 639-1 codes (e.g. en, fr, de)

search_recency_filter.description: Filter by publication recency (hour, day, week, month, or year)

search_after_date_filter.description: Return results published after this date (MM/DD/YYYY)

search_before_date_filter.description: Return results published before this date (MM/DD/YYYY)

last_updated_before_filter.description: Return results last updated before this date (MM/DD/YYYY)

last_updated_after_filter.description: Return results last updated after this date (MM/DD/YYYY)

image_format_filter.description: Filter image results by format (e.g. png, jpg)

image_domain_filter.description: Limit image results to specific domains

stream_mode.description: Controls the format of streaming events. 'full' suppresses reasoning events and includes metadata inline; 'concise' emits reasoning events separately

reasoning_effort.description: Controls how much effort the model spends on reasoning

language_preference.description: ISO 639-1 language code for preferred response language

operations.name: Create contextualized embeddings
operations.description: Generate contextualized embeddings for document chunks. Chunks from the same document share context awareness, improving retrieval quality for document-based applications.

input.description: Nested array structure where each inner array contains chunks from a single document. Chunks within the same document are encoded with document-level context awareness. Maximum 512 documents. Total chunks across all documents must not exceed 16,000. Total tokens per document must not exceed 32K. All chunks in a single request must not exceed 120,000 tokens combined. Empty strings are not allowed.

model.description: The contextualized embedding model to use

dimensions.description: Number of dimensions for output embeddings (Matryoshka). Range: 128-1024 for pplx-embed-context-v1-0.6b, 128-2560 for pplx-embed-context-v1-4b. Defaults to full dimensions (1024 or 2560).

encoding_format.description: Output encoding format for embeddings. base64_int8 returns base64-encoded signed int8 values. base64_binary returns base64-encoded packed binary (1 bit per dimension).

operations.name: Create agent response
operations.description: Generate a response for the provided input with optional web search and reasoning.

input.description: Input content - either a string or array of input items

background.description: Run the response asynchronously. With `stream: false`, the request returns immediately with `status: "queued"`; poll `GET /v1/responses/{id}` until the response reaches a terminal status. Background runs are durable, so you can also stream them and reconnect after a drop.

language_preference.description: ISO 639-1 language code for response language

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. This is a shared optional Agent API request parameter, but it is required when using anthropic/* models. If omitted for an Anthropic model, the API returns HTTP 400 with: validation failed: max_output_tokens is required when using Anthropic models.

max_steps.description: Maximum number of research loop steps. If provided, overrides the preset's max_steps value. For requests that specify model or models without a preset, the default is 1. Set max_steps to at least 3 when using finance_search with a direct model so the agent has enough steps to initialize and run the tool. Must be >= 1 if specified. Maximum allowed is 100.

model.description: Model ID in provider/model format (e.g., "openai/gpt-5", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6"). If models is also provided, models takes precedence. Required if neither models nor preset is provided.

models.description: Model fallback chain. Each model is in provider/model format. Models are tried in order until one succeeds. Max 5 models allowed. If set, takes precedence over single model field. The response.model will reflect the model that actually succeeded.

preset.description: Preset configuration name (e.g., "fast", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh"). Pre-configured model with system prompt and search parameters. Required if model is not provided.

profile.description: Saved, versioned configuration to run with. The version is resolved when the request is admitted. Cannot be combined with preset.

previous_response_id.description: OpenAI-compatible previous response id for multi-turn response chains. When set, the new response continues from the completed prior response's saved state. The prior response must belong to the same account and have completed.

response_format.description: Specifies the desired output format for the model response

store.description: OpenAI-compatible storage toggle. When false, the response is hidden from later retrieve calls, and the echoed response reports `store: false`. It can still be used as a `previous_response_id` continuation source.

stream.description: If true, returns SSE stream instead of JSON

skills.description: Built-in, request-scoped inline, and organization-owned custom skills available to the model. Skill metadata is disclosed to the model up front; full instructions are loaded on demand through the load_skill tool. Selecting any skill enables the sandbox tool for the request. Requests with skills run on the durable backend and skills are not echoed back on Response objects.

temperature.description: OpenAI-compatible sampling temperature forwarded to generation.

top_p.description: OpenAI-compatible nucleus sampling parameter forwarded to generation.

operations.name: Create async chat completion
operations.description: Submit an asynchronous chat completion request.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate requests

operations.name: Create a skill
operations.description: Creates a skill from a zip bundle. The bundle must contain a `SKILL.md` that provides the skill name and description; those fields are read from the bundle, not from the request.

operations.name: Delete a skill
operations.description: Deletes a skill. Pass the current revision as `expected_revision`; the delete fails with `409` if the skill has a newer revision, so a delete never races a concurrent update.

skill_id.description: Skill identifier returned by create or `GET /v1/skills`

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision token the skill must currently be at. The write applies only if it matches, so it cannot race a concurrent update.

operations.name: Download agent response file
operations.description: Download the raw bytes of a file the response delivered with the `share_file` tool. The `file_id` comes from the file list endpoint and is distinct from the response `id`. The response streams raw bytes, not JSON, with a `Content-Type` matching the file and a `Content-Disposition: attachment` header carrying the original filename.

file_id.description: File id from the file list endpoint

operations.name: Get a skill download url
operations.description: Returns a short-lived URL to download the skill bundle as a zip. Without `revision`, returns the active revision.

skill_id.description: Skill identifier returned by create or `GET /v1/skills`

revision.description: Opaque revision token; when omitted, the active revision is used

operations.name: Create embeddings
operations.description: Generate embeddings for a list of texts. Use these embeddings for semantic search, clustering, and other machine learning applications.

input.description: Input text to embed, encoded as a string or array of strings. Maximum 512 texts per request. Each input must not exceed 32K tokens. All inputs in a single request must not exceed 120,000 tokens combined. Empty strings are not allowed.

dimensions.description: Number of dimensions for output embeddings (Matryoshka). Range: 128-1024 for pplx-embed-v1-0.6b, 128-2560 for pplx-embed-v1-4b. Defaults to full dimensions (1024 or 2560).

encoding_format.description: Output encoding format for embeddings. base64_int8 returns base64-encoded signed int8 values. base64_binary returns base64-encoded packed binary (1 bit per dimension).

operations.name: Get async chat completion
operations.description: Retrieve the response for a given asynchronous chat completion request.

operations.name: Usage analytics
operations.description: Returns your organization's Perplexity usage analytics as a bucketed time series for a single dataset. Requires an organization analytics API key, generated by an org admin from Settings → Organization → Computer in the Perplexity web app. Only complete UTC grid buckets are returned: start_time snaps down to its bucket, and the in-progress bucket is never included. Datasets differ in what they cou

dataset.description: The dataset to query. query_volume and daily_active_users are daily organization-level datasets: they reject bucket_width=1h and user_email.

start_time.description: Window start in unix seconds (UTC), inclusive. Snapped down to the bucket grid, so the first bucket can include usage from before this time.

end_time.description: Window end in unix seconds (UTC), exclusive. Defaults to now; future values are capped at now. The window may span at most 90 days.

bucket_width.description: Bucket size. Buckets align to the UTC grid. Not accepted as 1h for query_volume or daily_active_users, which are stored at day grain.

limit.description: Buckets per page. 1d: default 7, max 31. 1h: default 24, max 168.

page.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_page. Valid only with the same query parameters it was issued for.

user_email.description: Restrict results to a single member of your organization. Emails that don't match a current member return a generic 400. Not available for query_volume or daily_active_users, which are aggregated per organization; use the v2 endpoint for per-member query volume.

operations.name: Usage analytics per member
operations.description: Returns your organization's Perplexity usage broken down per member, as daily buckets. Each day lists one row per member with usage that day, keyed by email. credit_usage carries the same Model and Credit Source breakdown as v1; query_volume carries Feature, Project and Comet. Uses the same organization analytics API key as v1. Only complete UTC days are returned; the in-progress day is never incl

dataset.description: The dataset to query. query_volume at this grain carries Feature, Project and Comet breakdowns, but not Model or Model Family.

group_by.description: The dimension to group each day's usage by. user_email is currently the only supported value.

start_time.description: Window start in unix seconds (UTC), inclusive. Snapped down to the day grid, so the first day can include usage from before this time.

end_time.description: Window end in unix seconds (UTC), exclusive. Defaults to now; future values are capped at now. The window may span at most 90 days.

limit.description: Member rows per page. Default 50, max 100. A page can span multiple days.

page.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_page. Valid only with the same query parameters it was issued for.

operations.name: Get a skill
operations.description: Returns a skill. Without `revision`, returns the active revision.

skill_id.description: Skill identifier returned by create or `GET /v1/skills`

revision.description: Opaque revision token; when omitted, the active revision is used

operations.name: List agent response files
operations.description: List the files a response produced in the sandbox and delivered with the `share_file` tool. Scoped to the authenticated account, which only ever sees its own files. File content is not returned inline; download it with the file content endpoint.

operations.name: List async chat completions
operations.description: Retrieve a list of all asynchronous chat completion requests for a given user.

operations.name: List models
operations.description: List the models available for the Agent API. Returns model identifiers that can be used with the `POST /v1/agent` endpoint. The response follows the OpenAI List Models format for compatibility with third-party tools.

operations.name: List skill revisions
operations.description: Lists the revisions of a skill, newest first.

skill_id.description: Skill identifier returned by create or `GET /v1/skills`

limit.description: Maximum items to return, 1 to 200; defaults to 50

page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous response's `next_page_token`

operations.name: List skills
operations.description: Lists the skills in your Project, newest first.

limit.description: Maximum items to return, 1 to 200; defaults to 50

page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous response's `next_page_token`

operations.name: Retrieve agent response
operations.description: Retrieve a response created earlier. Returns a JSON snapshot of the response. Only responses created with `store` omitted or `true` can be retrieved; `store: false` responses return a 404.

operations.name: Search the web
operations.description: Search the web and retrieve relevant web page contents.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results. Values above 20 require search_type=people. Supports up to 20 for web search and up to 50 for people search.

search_type.description: Search type - "web" for general web search, "people" for people search. max_results above 20 is only supported for people search.

search_context_size.description: Controls how much content is extracted from result pages. - `low` — short passages most relevant to the query. - `medium` — a balanced amount of content per document. - `high` (default) — detailed content relevant to the query. Omit when using `max_tokens` or `max_tokens_per_page`.

max_tokens.description: Maximum total webpage content tokens to return across all search results

max_tokens_per_page.description: Maximum webpage content tokens to extract from each result page

operations.name: Add a skill revision
operations.description: Uploads a new zip bundle as a new revision of an existing skill. Pass the revision you expect to replace as the required `expected_revision`; the request fails with `409` if the skill has already moved past it, so the update cannot race a concurrent write. Name and description are re-read from the new bundle.

skill_id.description: Skill identifier returned by create or `GET /v1/skills`

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision token the skill must currently be at. The write applies only if it matches, so it cannot race a concurrent update.
